items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Well, Art Tatum, because of his genius and his dedication to his art form.

ctx.x: O.K. I think I want to ask one more question before we wind this reel up. Over the course of your life in the music business, what individuals have most impressed you, as people, maybe as people and as musicians?
Well, Art Tatum, because of his genius and his dedication to his art form. Lester

Young, dedicated to his art form. And, as far as saxophone players are concerned, Coleman Hawkins, because of his overall knowledge of music and his life-style. You know what I mean, as far as takin' care of himself, wearing good clothes and eating properly and getting his rest, you know, and having the best that life has to offer. That impressed me, you know. And then I admired Bird for his dedication, in spite of all the suffering and what not that he went through in his life. He still played pretty. And then,…
